evidence: Pairwise review of all 2 gate + 41 functional + 5 polish + 5 visual criteria. Strengths: functional rows carry explicit ownership hand-offs that prevent duplicate grading: hro_arrive_bottom defers multi-card arrival to hro_bulk_move; hro_interview_full defers overfill by bulk to hro_bulk_places and by undo to hro_undo_full; hro_drafts defers post-send clearing to hro_msg_compose; hro_candidate_view defers privacy to hro_candidate_private and replies to hro_msg_exchange; hro_candidate_linked alone owns the email link; hro_activity_refusals alone owns refused-action lines (prompt line 19); hro_pol_live_thread cedes scrolled-up view to Functional. Functional prompt line 23 and visual prompt line 14 both say never deduct one observed defect in more than one row. Role rows split by actor (mgr_late_stages / mgr_early_refused / mgr_other_job / observer_readonly / candidate_no_staff / anonymous); reads vs writes for candidates (candidate_private vs candidate_no_staff). No incompatible demands found: refused_put_back moving focus to the card after the user's own refused move does not conflict with the instruction's 'never move my cursor' on others' updates; hro_msg_compose empty box after a successful send is compatible with hro_pol_failed_send/hro_pol_session_resume keeping text after an unsent send; hro_undo_full (L: Mei's move on A does not block Rafael's undo of E) is consistent with hro_undo_conflict/hro_undo_once and rules Undo section; hro_candidate_view status wording is compatible with candidate_private's ban on reasons/positions; 401 for anonymous vs not-found for foreign conversation are different observables. Shared prerequisites (live delivery required by hro_live_board and hro_pol_live_board; refusal required by hro_interview_full and hro_refused_put_back; bulk/reorder used as setup for undo rows) are required positive controls per REVIEW_POLICY ('A dead feature must not earn credit for doing nothing') and grade different observables, so they are not duplicates. Gate legs repeated in hro_job_open/hro_add_candidate are the template's zero-weight gate pattern. Visual hro_vis_type anchor 5 'deliberate hierarchy' slightly overlaps hro_vis_hierarchy, mirroring the template, and visual prompt line 14 forbids double deduction (Note only). DEFECT: unsaved-note-draft persistence is graded in two polish criteria, and polish/prompt.md is the only scored prompt lacking the 'do not deduct the same observed defect in more than one row' guard. tests/scored/polish/judge.toml hro_pol_failed_send (weight 1.5) ends 'Also type an unsaved note on a card, reload, reopen the card: the note is still there ... Fails if ... the note draft is lost on reload.' hro_pol_session_resume (weight 2.5) also requires 'an unsaved note on one of your cards, sign out, sign in as Mei Lin ... Sign out and sign in as Rafael again: his reply and note drafts are still there.' Both derive from one rules sentence (hireops_rules.md Internal notes: 'A note that is being typed and has not been saved is kept for that person on that browser until it is saved'). The note leg is unrelated to failed sends, so it is a separately useful promise bundled into hro_pol_failed_send, contrary to REVIEW_POLICY 'Independent credit takes precedence over flow grouping', and it collides with the note leg of hro_pol_session_resume. Static review only; no runtime evidence was needed or used for this row.
counterexample: App X implements failed-send handling perfectly (explanation shown, text kept, sent once on retry) and reply drafts perfectly (stored per user+conversation, sign-in prompt on ended session, Mei sees none), but keeps unsaved card notes only in memory, and sign-out reloads the page. One defect (note drafts not persisted) zeroes hro_pol_failed_send (1.5) and hro_pol_session_resume (2.5): 4.0 of 12.0 polish weight (33%, about 6.7% of total reward) lost, although the headline promise of each row is fully met; a fair rubric would deduct it in one row.
suggested_fix: Remove the note-reload leg from hro_pol_failed_send and grade unsaved-note persistence in exactly one polish row (e.g. hro_pol_session_resume or a separate note-draft row covering reload and sign-out), and add the 'do not deduct the same observed defect in more than one row' line to polish/prompt.md as functional and visual already have.
